materials.name: MEGTRON 6 R-5775
materials.peel_condition: 1 oz (35 um) H-VLP copper, as received

lamination.notes: Keep the product above 185 C for more than 75 min; 195 C for 120 min is preferred. Press pressure goes up between 90 and 110 C of material temperature at the platen side: 3.0 MPa when the rate of rise is 4.0 C/min, 3.5 MPa at 3.0 C/min and 4.0 MPa at 2.0 C/min (guide values, optimised per circuit pattern). Vacuum stops 30 min after the start (at 90-130 C of material temperature). Cushion (kraft paper) needed. A DSC Tg above 180 C is recommended for the boards.

drilling.retract_notes: Maximum of the table of the guide (velocity 100-150 m/min; chip load up to 45 um per rev for 0.90 mm bits, spindle speed adjusted to reach the velocity; 700-1000 hits for bits up to 0.45 mm and 1,400-2,000 above). Lubricated entry sheet and high helix bits recommended; peck drilling for thin bits.

processing.bake_note: Dry finished innerlayers with a racked bake of 20-30 min at 105 C.

materials.notes: Laminate R-5775 in its normal glass cloth versions (K and G; the S and R types carry buried resistor foil); prepreg R-5670. Dk and Df at 1 and 10 GHz are those of the 0.75 mm sample (core type 30, 2116 glass, 54 % resin); the values at 12 GHz (0.004 Df) and 13 GHz (Dk 3.62, Df 0.0046) come from the short sheets of the same material. CTE x and y below Tg 14-16 ppm/C (a range, so the fields are empty); T288 above 120 min with and without copper; volume resistivity 1e9 MOhm cm and surface resistivity 1e8 MOhm (C-96/35/90) converted to ohm. Thickness list is the union of the core types of the K and G tables (the K table stops at 0.75 mm); each core type also lists its glass style, plies and resin content in the sheet. The thicknesses are the actual core thicknesses without copper.

materials.name: R-1766
materials.peel_condition: 35 um copper, A; 12 um 1.35, 18 um 1.57, 35 um 1.96, 70 um 2.94 N/mm (the same after the S4 treatment)
materials.notes: Double-sided FR-4.0 glass cloth epoxy core (laminate R-1766, prepreg R-1661) with good second lamination moldability, little resin smear and fast drilling. Thickness tolerance +-0.03 mm (0.1 mm) up to +-0.13 mm (1.6 mm). Dk 4.8 and Df 0.016 at 1 MHz after D-24/23 (4.7 and 0.015 as received); solder float at 260 C 120 s or more; flexural strength crosswise 490 N/mm2; Tg, Td, T288 and CTE are the figures of the 'conventional FR-4 R-1766' column of the HIPER sheets; Dk at 1 GHz and flammability by IPC-TM-650 2.5.5.9 and UL 94 on 1.6 mm samples. Volume resistivity 5e7 MOhm m and surface resistivity 5e6 MOhm (C-96/20/65) converted to ohm cm and ohm.

materials.name: R-1661

materials.name: FELIOS RF775
materials.peel_condition: as fabricated and after solder, IPC-TM-650 2.4.9 (1.7 kN/m)
materials.notes: RF775 is the double sided type (RF770 is single sided). Polyimide thickness 25, 50 and 100 um (the product table also lists 0.0005, 0.00058, 0.0008, 0.001, 0.002, 0.003 and 0.004 in) with rolled-annealed foil of Q, T, H, 1 or 2 oz (ED foil on request; the meaning of the letters Q, T and H is not given). Tg 343 C is published without a method (the features list says 340 C) and is not stored; CTE 18 ppm/K by TMA between 250 and 100 C; coefficient of humidity expansion 10 ppm/%RH; elongation 93 %; Poisson's ratio 0.3; MIT folding endurance 220 cycles (25 um) and 60 (50 um); flexural endurance more than 10000 cycles; volume and surface resistivity more than 1E+14 ohm cm and ohm (bounds, not stored); dielectric strength 7 kV/mil (converted); 160 C UL operating temperature; dielectric thickness tolerance 10 %.
